name: Beef Burger Patties with Garlic Aioli & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber
1 ½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem ends; cut the quarters crosswise into 1 ¼-cm-thick chunks and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the cucumber; quarter the cucumber lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1 ¼-cm-thick pieces and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallots; peel and halve the shallots lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-rounds and add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
In a medium bowl, combine and mix together the ground beef, salt, and pepper. Form the mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the burger patties in the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Juice the lemons; add ½ of the juice to the salad bowl and transfer the other ½ to a small bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Add to the small bowl with the lemon juice.
To the lemon juice and garlic, add mayonnaise, salt, and pepper; mix together until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the salad between plates; place the burger patties on the side and serve with the garlic aioli. Enjoy!
